status: draft: every null below is a person's decision (#127), and nothing is judged until none is left

wrongFix.commentOnlyNote: comment-only stacked on the correct undo leaves the game correct, so #127's 'bad by construction' does not hold for these 8 pairs. Sean labels them good or bad before any result exists.
wrongFix.publicSamRule: With no private set, the verifier's held-out arm is left out of the bench's decision: it is a constant fixture with SAM off and a forced needs-review with SAM on. Only a check that ran and failed is a catch.

oracle.definition: visible when the engine record (player position, facing, enemies, shots) differs from the clean game's by more than traceThresholdPx, or more than frameThreshold frames differ. Both strictly over.

agreement.definition: SAM's own checks (player-always-visible, coins-visible) on a cheap rejection. Agree: one fails. Disagree: all pass, so SAM saw nothing wrong and could never have overturned the rejection. Undecided: otherwise. Gameplay, the controls and the ground check are left out: both arms share the first two, and the ground line comes from the engine.

crashDefinition: A crash is a game that does not run or never loads a player. A game that runs with a failed load is judged as usual, with loadFailures recorded on its row: a missing texture is the bug a resource-path mutant makes. This decides whether the resource-path class is in the study, and it was settled after a resource-path mutant had been seen caught in a rehearsal (run 41244617649). Sean accepted it on Oct 31, 2026.

excludedBeforeDraw.decidedBy: Sean, Oct 31, 2026: every case judged before registration leaves the study before the draw. This does not depend on their outcomes, and the code changed after those outcomes were seen.

rehearsedBeforeRegistration: Disclosed, since these outcomes were seen before registration. Mutation bench runs 41234250269 and 41239537985 judged the pair dev/physics-fall-through/v1 + freeze (one of the 48): caught-cheap. Runs 41244619862 and 41246831297 judged it again through forced SAM: caught-cheap, SAM's own checks disagree, as a frozen robot is still visible. Run 41246829062 judged it once more without SAM: caught-cheap. The last two used the judge benchmark's freeze fixture, whose game is identical to this pair. Run 41244617649 judged two members of the mutant population: code:player/player.gd:7:sign.WALK_SPEED (visible, passed the cheap tier) and resource-path:player/player.tscn:3:missing (visible, caught-cheap). All three cases are excluded before the draw (excludedBeforeDraw). Rehearsals since then use cases the study cannot draw.
retryRule: A replay that fails is tried once more, and the retry is recorded. Failing twice is a crash of the case. Nothing is rerun because of how Expectrail did on it.
